name: Aberration and Vision Correction via Zernike Polynomials
definition: Using Zernike polynomials to pre-compensate for optical aberrations and vision deficiencies by shaping the wavefront for each object point.
summary: Aberration and Vision Correction via Zernike Polynomials pre-compensates for optical errors by replacing simple lens phase functions with parameterized wavefront corrections offering unlimited degrees of freedom for spatially variant correction.
